description: The Phase 1 scalar corpus (phase1.md MT.2): first-order, total programs over Nat and Bool, compiled by ix with unfolding equations; expected outputs from Lean 4.34's interpreter and independent constants.

producer.ix: the ix of this repository: lake build ix at the repository root, in its dev shell (not a Nix build)

origins.name: collatz, collatzBest, isPrime, primeCount, sigma, isPerfect, perfectCount, chooseMul, choosePascal, lcmUpTo, factorial, isqrt, powMod, digitSum

roots.name: Scalar.tailfib
roots.note: constants: F(n); F(93) is the first without a word

roots.name: Scalar.collatzBest
roots.note: constants: OEIS A006877 (record setters); the loop state (best, most) is an immortal pair per iteration, so a run allocates in proportion to its limit (10000 outgrew the word levels' 64 KiB region on 2026-10-01: status 1 there, ok natively)

roots.name: Scalar.chooseMul
roots.note: C(66, 33) has a word but c (n - i) does not before the division: status 3 is allowed

roots.name: Scalar.lcmUpTo
roots.note: lcm(1..42) has a word but Nat.lcm's m * n does not: status 3 is allowed

roots.name: Scalar.isqrt
roots.note: independent check: r^2 <= n < (r+1)^2. At n = 2^63 - 1 the guard n < 2 is Nat.decLt, which computes n + 1 <= 2: status 3 is allowed at the word levels

roots.name: Scalar.powMod
roots.note: constants: Fermat, 5^(p-1) mod p = 1 for p = 10^9 + 7

roots.name: Scalar.digitSum
roots.note: At n = 2^63 - 1 the guard n < 10 computes n + 1 <= 10 (Nat.decLt): status 3 is allowed at the word levels

roots.name: entry
roots.note: constants: upstream .out.expected, line by line (the three values of a without a word return status 3)
